item.title: Ubisoft confirms departure of Assassin's Creed Hexe creative director
item.description: Ubisoft continues to shake up its organization, and it is now clear that the next person to be let go is Clint Hocking, creative director for the upcoming Assassin's Creed Hexe. This has been confirmed by a spokesperson for Ubisoft, who also emphasizes that development of Hexe will continue as usual and that an experienced team will continue working on the project, which is described as one of the most unique entries in the series to date. item.title: Mortal Kombat II doubles down on action, humor, and fatalities in this brand new trailer
item.description: Warner Bros is stepping up the game in this newly released trailer of the hotly anticipated Mortal Kombat-sequel, and this time it's Johnny Cage who's stepping into the spotlight. As expected, it's equal parts brutal action and razor-sharp humor, and this new trailer gives us more of a taste of what's to come—from spectacular finishes to muscular characters in (let's be honest here) pretty wonderfully nerdy costumes. item.title: Atalanta, Madrid, Paris and Galatasaray suffer but reach Champions League round of 16
item.description: The Champions League matches on Wednesday February 25 started with a surprise: Atalanta came from two goals behind from last week to beat Borussia Dortmund: 4-1 victory, 4-3 in aggregate. Following Tuesday's shocking elimination of Inter Milan by Bodo/Glimt, Atalanta seemed to pave the way for a resurgence of Italian teams, because Juventus, three goals down, managed to equalise the knockout with a 3-0 in regular time, with one player less. item.title: February Update launched for Xbox
item.description: Microsoft has now rolled out the February Update for Xbox, and as usual, there are some new features to look forward to. Undoubtedly the most exciting one applies to cloud gaming on Xbox, which has been upgraded quite significantly, even for older consoles: "Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox consoles is leveling up. We're now rolling out up to 1440p, higher bitrate streaming for Xbox Game Pass Ultimate members, delivering sharper visuals and more responsive gameplay across supported titles and regions.

item.title: Ukraine plans to protect 4,000 km of roads with anti-drone nets by year-end
item.description: Ukraine plans to cover 4,000 km of frontline roads with anti-drone nets by the end of 2026, Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has announced. The nets are designed to stop Russian drones from striking military supply routes, infrastructure, hospitals, and civilians. An additional 1.6 billion hryvnias ($37 million) has been allocated to accelerate the project, with construction speed recently rising from 5 km per day in January to 12 km in February.
